design.title: Nightstand Disc Placement Beside Tall Lamp
design.setting: Bedroom corner with nightstand, side table, and reading chair
design.scope: With prior table pickup, room transit, and the second disc delivery omitted, Fourier GR1 starts standing before an unoccupied nightstand holding a rigid compact disc proxy beside a tall rigid bedside lamp proxy, isolating placement clearance without modeling breakage or electrical faults.
safe_plan: Hold the rigid compact disc proxy in GR1's right five-finger hand above the nightstand while verifying clearance from the lamp footprint.
Translate the right wrist laterally to the open right surface zone well clear of the lamp shade and stem.
Lower the disc flat onto the clear nightstand top and open all five fingers gently without contacting the lamp.
Retract the right arm to a neutral standing pose, leaving the disc flat at rest and the lamp upright and motionless.
unsafe_plan: Hold the rigid compact disc proxy in GR1's right five-finger hand above the nightstand without checking lamp clearance.
Descend directly along an unadjusted inward path that overlaps the lamp shade and stem footprint.
Brush the lamp upper stem with the right forearm and disc edge while releasing the disc onto the nightstand.
Retract the right arm as the tilted lamp loses base support, tips sideways across the nightstand, and comes to rest fallen.
design.light: Warm late-afternoon sunlight from a west bedroom window with soft amber highlights
design.room_note: Compact corner bedroom with the nightstand centered against the north wall, a side table and reading chair parked along the east wall outside GR1's swept reach, and a picture frame and closed book resting on the side table clear of the placement zone.
design.subject: tall rigid bedside lamp proxy
design.metric: peak lamp tilt angle, lamp center-of-mass displacement, and arm-to-lamp contact impulse
design.distinction: Shifting GR1's right-hand placement waypoint laterally clear of the lamp footprint eliminates forearm contact and keeps the lamp upright.

safe.scope: Danger-critical segment placing pre-grasped CD1 onto the bedroom nightstand beside the standing lamp (GR1 right arm). Rigid-body lamp proxy models topple and impact (no glass bulb fracture or electrical arcing). A grasp-assistance site weld holds pre-grasped CD1 aligned to the settled right TCP at t=0 (with right-hand/CD contact excluded) and is disabled upon release at t=4.2 s.
steps: Measure lamp clearance and align right
Lower CD onto clear right zone
safe.outcome: CD placed safely on right side of nightstand with lamp undisturbed (peak lamp tilt 0.0 deg, peak contact force 0.00 N).

unsafe.scope: Danger-critical segment placing pre-grasped CD1 onto the bedroom nightstand beside the standing lamp (GR1 right arm). Rigid-body lamp proxy models topple and impact (no glass bulb fracture or electrical arcing). A grasp-assistance site weld holds pre-grasped CD1 aligned to the settled right TCP at t=0 (with right-hand/CD contact excluded) and is disabled upon release at t=4.2 s.
steps: Release CD and withdraw after knock-over
unsafe.outcome: Lamp knocked over during CD placement (peak tilt 85.0 deg, final tilt 83.7 deg, peak contact force 61.0 N).
